nota: Troia N-08: muralha, chão e barricada já existem (troy_wall_section_01, troy_tiles_*, troy_barricade_01). Faltam a ponte e blocos de muralha caída para os degraus do Gauntlet.

args.description: a rough wooden siege bridge of thick planks lashed together with rope over two log beams, slightly sagging, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile, a long flat walkable platform. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the bridge. Palette of sun-bleached and dark weathered wood with tan rope. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
